metadata.description: SZ Work Suite - internal Claude Cowork plugin marketplace for SZ business & management support teams. 212 skills: strategy, finance, legal, HR, procurement/logistics, sales support, risk management, marketing, plus 6 SZ-specific skills (UZ research, risk radar, document formats, trade & customs, sample stocktaking, ISA sales verification).
